name: [UPD] Make a Brainrot Army⚔️
desc:
Welcome to Make a Brainrot Army! ⚔️
Are you ready to build the largest Brainrot army? 
Place the troops in the strategic design and click attack! 
Upgrade your troops and upgrade your designs!

🛠️  Use strategy to place your Brainrot troops!
💥  Click "Attack" to launch your surprise attack!
💪  Unlock new troops with special abilities
⏰  Remember, your army is attacking offline!  🤑

🎁 Codes: ARMY, MONEY, WINS
